018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.compress.zstd;
019
020import com.github.luben.zstd.ZstdDecompressCtx;
021import com.github.luben.zstd.ZstdDictDecompress;
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
023import java.io.IOException;
024import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
025import org.apache.hadoop.conf.Configuration;
026import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.compress.BlockDecompressorHelper;
027import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.compress.ByteBuffDecompressor;
028import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.compress.CanReinit;
029import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.nio.ByteBuff;
030import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.nio.SingleByteBuff;
031import org.apache.yetus.audience.InterfaceAudience;
032
033/**
034 * Glue for ByteBuffDecompressor on top of zstd-jni
035 */
036@InterfaceAudience.Private
037public class ZstdByteBuffDecompressor implements ByteBuffDecompressor, CanReinit {
038
039  protected int dictId;
040  @Nullable
041  protected ZstdDictDecompress dict;
042  protected ZstdDecompressCtx ctx;
043  // Intended to be set to false by some unit tests
044  private boolean allowByteBuffDecompression;
045
046  ZstdByteBuffDecompressor(@Nullable byte[] dictionary) {
047    ctx = new ZstdDecompressCtx();
048    if (dictionary != null) {
049      this.dictId = ZstdCodec.getDictionaryId(dictionary);
050      this.dict = new ZstdDictDecompress(dictionary);
051      this.ctx.loadDict(this.dict);
052    }
053    allowByteBuffDecompression = true;
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  public boolean canDecompress(ByteBuff output, ByteBuff input) {
058    return allowByteBuffDecompression && output instanceof SingleByteBuff
059      && input instanceof SingleByteBuff;
060  }
061
062  @Override
063  public int decompress(ByteBuff output, ByteBuff input, int inputLen) throws IOException {
064    return BlockDecompressorHelper.decompress(output, input, inputLen, this::decompressRaw);
065  }
066
067  private int decompressRaw(ByteBuff output, ByteBuff input, int inputLen) throws IOException {
068    if (output instanceof SingleByteBuff && input instanceof SingleByteBuff) {
069      ByteBuffer nioOutput = output.nioByteBuffers()[0];
070      ByteBuffer nioInput = input.nioByteBuffers()[0];
071      int origOutputPos = nioOutput.position();
072      int n;
073      if (nioOutput.isDirect() && nioInput.isDirect()) {
074        n = ctx.decompressDirectByteBuffer(nioOutput, nioOutput.position(),
075          nioOutput.limit() - nioOutput.position(), nioInput, nioInput.position(), inputLen);
076      } else if (!nioOutput.isDirect() && !nioInput.isDirect()) {
077        n = ctx.decompressByteArray(nioOutput.array(),
078          nioOutput.arrayOffset() + nioOutput.position(), nioOutput.limit() - nioOutput.position(),
079          nioInput.array(), nioInput.arrayOffset() + nioInput.position(), inputLen);
080      } else if (nioOutput.isDirect() && !nioInput.isDirect()) {
081        n = ctx.decompressByteArrayToDirectByteBuffer(nioOutput, nioOutput.position(),
082          nioOutput.limit() - nioOutput.position(), nioInput.array(),
083          nioInput.arrayOffset() + nioInput.position(), inputLen);
084      } else if (!nioOutput.isDirect() && nioInput.isDirect()) {
085        n = ctx.decompressDirectByteBufferToByteArray(nioOutput.array(),
086          nioOutput.arrayOffset() + nioOutput.position(), nioOutput.limit() - nioOutput.position(),
087          nioInput, nioInput.position(), inputLen);
088      } else {
089        throw new IllegalStateException("Unreachable line");
090      }
091
092      nioOutput.position(origOutputPos + n);
093      nioInput.position(input.position() + inputLen);
094
095      return n;
096    } else {
097      throw new IllegalStateException(
098        "At least one buffer is not a SingleByteBuff, this is not supported");
099    }
100  }
101
102  @Override
103  public void close() {
104    ctx.close();
105    if (dict != null) {
106      dict.close();
107    }
108  }
109
110  @Override
111  public void reinit(Configuration conf) {
112    if (conf != null) {
113      // Dictionary may have changed
114      byte[] b = ZstdCodec.getDictionary(conf);
115      if (b != null) {
116        // Don't casually create dictionary objects; they consume native memory
117        int thisDictId = ZstdCodec.getDictionaryId(b);
118        if (dict == null || dictId != thisDictId) {
119          dictId = thisDictId;
120          ZstdDictDecompress oldDict = dict;
121          dict = new ZstdDictDecompress(b);
122          ctx.loadDict(dict);
123          if (oldDict != null) {
124            oldDict.close();
125          }
126        }
127      } else {
128        ZstdDictDecompress oldDict = dict;
129        dict = null;
130        dictId = 0;
131        // loadDict((byte[]) accepts null to clear the dictionary
132        ctx.loadDict((byte[]) null);
133        if (oldDict != null) {
134          oldDict.close();
135        }
136      }
137
138      // unit test helper
139      this.allowByteBuffDecompression =
140        conf.getBoolean("hbase.io.compress.zstd.allowByteBuffDecompression", true);
141    }
142  }
143}
